content:
{'text': '一名女子指控七名康奈爾大學學生在兄弟會屋內強姦她，她表示大學校長質疑她為何延遲報案，令她感到「得不到支持且不被相信」。', 'paragraph_context': 'A woman who accused seven Cornell University students of raping her at a fraternity house says the university’s president questioned why she waited to report the alleged assault, leaving her feeling “unsupported and disbelieved.”'}

{'text': '她轉述校長言論的二手版本遭到康奈爾否認，正值教師準備就這所常春藤盟校領導層進行不信任投票之際。她上週致函教師領導層，美聯社於週二取得該信。', 'paragraph_context': 'Her secondhand account of the president’s remark, which Cornell disputes, comes as faculty prepare for a potential vote of no confidence in the Ivy League school’s leadership. She sent a letter to faculty leaders last week, which The Associated Press obtained Tuesday.'}

{'text': '這名前學生在法庭文件中化名Jane Doe，她提出的性侵指控引發校園抗議，令校方紀律制度再次受到審視，並促使州政府介入調查據稱發生於2024年10月的襲擊事件。', 'paragraph_context': 'The sexual assault allegations by the former student, called Jane Doe in court documents, have sparked campus protests, renewed scrutiny of the university’s disciplinary system and a state investigation into the alleged October 2024 assault.'}

{'text': 'Jane Doe在信中表示，她的姊妹會會長告訴她，康奈爾大學校長Michael Kotlikoff曾質疑她為何等到下個月才報案。這名於2024年11月與Kotlikoff交談的姊妹會負責人，將他的言辭理解為對她說法的質疑。', 'paragraph_context': 'In the letter, Jane Doe said her sorority president told her that Cornell President Michael Kotlikoff questioned why she waited until the following month to report being assaulted. The sorority leader, who spoke with Kotlikoff in November 2024, interpreted his remark as casting doubt on her story.'}

{'text': '「Kotlikoff校長的初步回應大意是：『她為什麼拖這麼久才報案？』」Jane Doe在信中寫道。她表示，這次對話令她對校方能否以她期望的敏感度及公正態度處理事件失去信心。', 'paragraph_context': '“President Kotlikoff’s initial response was along the lines of, ‘Why did she wait so long to report it?’” Jane Doe wrote in the letter. She said the conversation made her less confident that the administration could handle what happened with the sensitivity and fairness she expected.'}

{'text': '然而，康奈爾的教師學院院長對該次對話有不同說法。教授Chris Schaffer在週二發給教師參議院的電郵中（經美聯社核實）表示，另一名在場的官員憶述Kotlikoff當時問的是為何旁觀者沒有透過學校的匿名爆料專線更早報案，尤其當指控已在社交媒體流傳。', 'paragraph_context': 'Cornell’s dean of faculty, however, offered a different account of the conversation. In an email Tuesday to faculty senators and verified by the AP, professor Chris Schaffer said another official who was present at the conversation recalled Kotlikoff asking why bystanders had not reported the alleged assault sooner through the school’s anonymous tip line, especially since the allegations were already circulating on social media.'}

{'text': 'Schaffer表示，在得到該次對話的另一個說法之前，他一直沒有將Jane Doe的信件轉交給教師參議院。他說已將信件轉交給校方律師，律師再轉交調查康奈爾處理手法的獨立小組。', 'paragraph_context': 'Schaffer said he waited to share Jane Doe’s letter with faculty senators until he could get another account of the conversation. He said he forwarded the letter to university lawyers, who passed it on to an independent team investigating Cornell’s response.'}

{'text': 'Schaffer在上週的會議上表示，他反對擬議中的不信任動議，理由是動議並無指出具體失誤或改善方案，但他承認教師們的不滿情緒。「校園裡的憤怒是合理的，我也感同身受。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Schaffer said at a meeting last week that he was against the proposed no-confidence resolution, saying it identified no specific failures or fixes, but acknowledged faculty frustration. “The anger in our community is justified and I share it.”'}

{'text': 'Kotlikoff週二未有回覆有關Jane Doe信件的查詢電郵。大學發言人的聲明亦反駁了她對該次對話的描述，指Kotlikoff當時問的是旁觀者的行動，而非針對Jane Doe。', 'paragraph_context': 'Kotlikoff did not respond Tuesday to an email inquiry about Jane Doe’s letter. A statement from a university spokesperson also disputed her account of the conversation, saying Kotlikoff was asking about bystanders’ actions rather than Jane Doe.'}

{'text': '她的信件透過律師發出，並最先由《紐約時報》報道，時值康奈爾教師考慮通過一項動議，對校方行政層處理部分教師所稱校園性侵「持續危機」的能力表示不信任。', 'paragraph_context': 'Her letter, transmitted through her attorney and first reported by The New York Times, comes as Cornell faculty consider a resolution declaring no confidence in the university administration’s ability to address what some faculty members have described as an “ongoing crisis” of sexual assault on campus.'}

{'text': '教師於上週三的會議上開始辯論該動議，期間Kotlikoff面對就校方處理性侵指控及監管兄弟會情況的尖銳提問。教師參議院預計於10月28日恢復辯論，其後進行電子投票。', 'paragraph_context': 'Faculty members began debating the resolution at a meeting last Wednesday, where Kotlikoff faced pointed questions about the school’s response to sexual assault allegations and its oversight of fraternities. The Faculty Senate is expected to resume debate on Oct. 28 before holding an electronic vote.'}

{'text': 'Jane Doe在信中表示，她希望教師們掌握可能與其審議相關的資料。她強調自己並非要左右他們的投票取向。', 'paragraph_context': 'In her letter, Jane Doe said she wanted faculty members to have information that might be relevant to their deliberations. She emphasized that she was not trying to tell them how to vote.'}

{'text': '「我的用意不是要規定參議院應該如何理解這段敘述，而是希望提供參議員們可加以考慮或進一步調查的資料，」她寫道。', 'paragraph_context': '“My intention is not to prescribe how the Senate should interpret this account, but rather to provide information that its members may wish to consider or investigate further,” she wrote.'}

{'text': '記者已留言向Jane Doe的代表律師Thomas Giuffra及W. Whitney Seals尋求回應。', 'paragraph_context': 'Messages seeking comment were left for Jane Doe’s lawyers, Thomas Giuffra and W. Whitney Seals.'}
